classes.owner: The sole dispatch state machine owns exactly-once acceptance; reviewer-agent owns all-leg settlement and post-settlement capability revocation; the receipt assembler owns verbatim report attachment; the semantic auditor consumes but neither transports nor rewrites reports.

Agent returns settlement identity/status only. Runtime retains exact successful report UTF-8 bytes length and SHA and assembles RuntimeReviewerReceiptV2. completed requires all required reports; refused preserves actual outcomes/reports and may carry only a separately typed diagnostic. This supersedes the historical aggregation-tag repair's driver-visible transport while preserving its evidence that reports were not previously available.
